Guidance & outlook: At the last year con call, we had a guidance of 40% revenue growth and 2 % gross margin improvement.
We now have a very strong order book of INR1,200 plus c rores, which provides us revenue visibility over and above our existing revenue and customers.
So that would be, we're expecting INR40 crores sort of revenue from the shock absorber line that we're setting up in Sanand.
Growth & demand: The financial year '26, we clocked 54% revenue growth with EBITDA margins of 19.5%.
In absolute terms, our export sales went up by 50%, while non - automotive revenue was up by 150%.

Of this, our automotive order book is approximately INR980 crores, while non -auto order book stands at approximately INR230 crores, both of which are to be served in over a period of six to seven years.
Margins & costs: And so to give you a solid number is difficult, but what I hope is that we can still grow our margins by 1 % this year, simply because our exports is going to be much larger and you'll see our defence revenue and our non-automotive revenue will continue to grow.
And yes , it's, we quote at least 10% plus over our domestic pricing for those parts.
So the 1 0-acre land, starting with that, costed us around INR17 crores to INR18 crores.
Capex & expansion: OBSC Perfection Limited May 21, 2026 During this year, we did a preferential issue of INR43.3 crores to augment our growth and invest in building mega factories.
So we've expanded our forging capacity by roughly 5 x to 6x kind of a scale jump post this Faridabad acquisition.
And so the total capex incurred including the tools, fixtures, everything that's needed to run the plant, run the business would be approximately INR9 crores.
Balance sheet & cash: As the year had uncertainty with tariffs and West Asia conflict, we proactively invested in working capital and built-up inventory to ensure business continuity.
So and as we generate cash, we're continuously deploying that, we've raised funds from equity, we're also sort of raising funds from debt.

So we do see continuous requirement of capital investment and hence tough to say, when our free cash flow will be positive, but the cash flow which whichever will be generated is of course going back into the business and that's what is sort of helping us to grow fast.
Risks & challenges: The management may make some forward -looking statements in today's presentation, and this must be understood along with the uncertainty and risk associated with the company and i n general the current scenario.
So this has been, no doubt this has been a challenging year, so was the last one.
And there is, this is a VUCA world, a lot of uncertainty.
